criteria.statement: every week of both plateaus, in every setting, has a Gulf bid, a Paranagua day, a yuan day and a day the chosen No. 2 soybean contract traded

criteria.name: B115-2
criteria.statement: no placebo window pair spans a dated soybean tariff document, and in every setting placebo pairs read Paranagua against the Gulf and Dalian against the Gulf

criteria.detail: setting A: Paranagua against the Gulf +0.1376, floor +0.0406 (median of 131 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 13 as large); Dalian against the Gulf, yuan at the market rate +0.1030, floor +0.0310 (median of 115 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 13 as large); Dalian against the Gulf, yuan at the pre-plateau rate +0.1592, floor +0.0475 (median of 115 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 1 as large); Dalian against Paranagua, yuan at the market rate -0.0346, floor +0.0760 (median of 115 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 76 as large); Dalian against Paranagua, yuan at the pre-plateau rate +0.0216, floor +0.0833 (median of 115 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 93 as large); log yuan per US dollar +0.0541, floor +0.0281 (median of 131 placebo pairs, 5 apart; 9 as large)
criteria.name: B115-3
criteria.statement: the moves of Paranagua and of Dalian against the Gulf, of Dalian against Paranagua, and of the yuan, with Dalian at the market rate and at the pre-plateau rate, are printed in every setting against their placebo floors

criteria.detail: matches (the low end above its floor); A: [+0.1376, +0.1918] -> matches; B: [+0.1171, +0.1621] -> matches; C: [+0.1370, +0.1877] -> matches; D: [+0.1164, +0.1581] -> matches
criteria.name: B115-4
criteria.statement: the tariff moved Paranagua up against the Gulf: every potential moves by w_e Delta u, and u at Paranagua lies between its values at the Gulf and at Dalian (Corollary 43.6, Theorem 42)

criteria.name: B115-5
criteria.statement: Paranagua moved no further against the Gulf than Dalian did, which is the tariff's part of Dalian against Paranagua being at least 0 (Corollary 43.6, Theorem 42)

criteria.name: B115-6
criteria.statement: the share h_e the step passed to Dalian against the Gulf, as an interval over Delta = ln(1.28/1.03): from below the larger of Paranagua against the Gulf and Dalian at the market rate, from above Dalian at the pre-plateau rate; and with no orientation assumed, each end moved out by the yuan's step

criteria.name: B115-7
criteria.statement: Paranagua minus the Gulf in US$/bu, averaged over the weeks ending 2018-06-29 to 2018-11-30 against the default pre plateau, has the sign of the $1.71/bu that Adjemian, Smith and He (2021) estimate against no tariff and lies within one order of magnitude of it
